wire.t: Jayden Daniels drove Washington 64 yards in 34 seconds with no timeouts to set up a walk-off 26-yard field goal in a 22-20 win over Cincinnati on Monday night. Daniels scored 18.06 for I Chase Brown Kids, but Ja'Marr Chase caught five passes for 31 yards, 5.6 points for LigmaBrocksAndLoveMyPenix, and LigmaBrocksAndLoveMyPenix still won by 10.38.

Rookie Antonio Williams caught nine passes for 122 yards Monday, including the 42-yarder that set up the winning kick: 19.2 points on the OBJAY bench. Jacory Croskey-Merritt ran for a touchdown and scored 16.7 sitting in the reserve slot of StrngeJhnsonHurtsmyBoutte. Chig Okonkwo added 12.1 on the LigmaBrocksAndLoveMyPenix bench.

Joe Burrow threw for 300 yards and two touchdowns in the loss, 23.9 for The Champ, and Tee Higgins caught one of them for 11.8. Samaje Perine had 97 total yards for 13.2 for StrngeJhnsonHurtsmyBoutte, and Stefon Diggs scored 7.5 for Dude, Your Getting a Dell, which lost by 71.66 and covered a 75.0-point spread by 3.34.

Justin Herbert entered the concussion protocol after the Chargers' 27-24 loss to the Jets and is Questionable for Week 12. Kraft for Cash has Bryce Young and Anthony Richardson Sr. behind him. Derrick Henry cleared the concussion protocol after Baltimore's loss to Carolina, good news for Hold My DK.

Drake Maye, who fractured his right fibula in Week 10, is still Out and still on New England's 53-man roster rather than IR. Carson Beck is listed Out again for Arizona, which means 40-year-old Josh Johnson is in line to start against Washington, and StrngeJhnsonHurtsmyBoutte is in line to start him.

The Raiders' coach said he's optimistic Brock Bowers (ankle/quadriceps) will be available against Cleveland on Sunday night. LigmaBrocksAndLoveMyPenix played Week 11 without him and got 5.0 from Isaiah Likely at tight end.

Set lineups early: Green Bay plays at the Rams on Wednesday night, then Bears-Lions, Eagles-Cowboys and Chiefs-Bills on Thanksgiving and Broncos-Steelers on Friday. No byes in Week 12. Jordan Love, Matthew Stafford, Kyren Williams, Tucker Kraft, Christian Watson and Matthew Golden all lock Wednesday at 8 PM ET.

League moves: no Week 12 transactions yet. Bill_Buttlicker still has Jacory Croskey-Merritt in an IR slot after he scored a touchdown Monday. jmello16 is still at $0 of FAAB spent. TheMoneyTeam2302 added Laquon Treadwell Thursday and got 0.0 from him.

stories.title: Week 11 final: Kraft for Cash hangs 197.20, LigmaBrocksAndLoveMyPenix survives Monday night and goes 10~1, and Dude, Your Getting a Dell is 0~11
stories.dek: I Chase Brown Kids needed 44.14 from three Monday players and got within 10.38. Rashod Bateman scored 16.2 on its bench.
body: Week 11 is in the books. Kraft for Cash beat OBJAY 197.20 to 91.64, the fourth-highest score in league history and the blowout of the week by 105.56. Jonah Coleman 35.4, CeeDee Lamb 28.7, Travis Kelce 26.9, Justin Herbert 26.44, and Jack Bech's 20.8 sat on taxi. BTaylor1 is 7~4.

Monday night almost got weird. I Chase Brown Kids went into Washington-Cincinnati down 44.14 with Jayden Daniels, Chase Brown and Mike Gesicki against Ja'Marr Chase. Daniels scored 18.06, Gesicki 14.7 and Brown 6.6, and Chase caught five balls for 31 yards, 5.6 points. That's 33.76 of the 44.14. LigmaBrocksAndLoveMyPenix won 146.16 to 135.78, its seventh straight, and Catfan94 is 10~1 with 1860.84 points. I Chase Brown Kids covered the 41.0 by a mile and lost anyway.

Here's the part ZachCarroll09 won't sleep on: Adonai Mitchell started at receiver and scored 4.5. Rashod Bateman scored 16.2 on the bench. That's an 11.7-point swing in a game lost by 10.38. Fernando Mendoza threw for 31.88 on the taxi squad too. I Chase Brown Kids is 4~7, and 135.78 was the highest losing score of the week.

Elsewhere: Hold My DK beat Dude, Your Getting a Dell 142.50 to 70.84, so TheMoneyTeam2302 is 10~1 and Br0phy is 0~11, though Stefon Diggs' 7.5 got Br0phy the cover by 3.34. Catfan94’s Farm Team beat Asian Jim 140.98 to 81.94. Jefferson’s Reserve beat Bourbon Lover 127.00 to 115.20 despite Dak Prescott's 44.9. And The Champ beat me 123.26 to 73.20 once Joe Burrow added 23.9 on Monday. I'm 3~8.

Week 12 is Thanksgiving week and there's a Wednesday night game, so set lineups by 8 PM ET Wednesday. Kraft for Cash vs Catfan94’s Farm Team for third place, The Champ vs Hold My DK, Jefferson’s Reserve vs I Chase Brown Kids, OBJAY vs Asian Jim where the loser is cooked, Bourbon Lover vs LigmaBrocksAndLoveMyPenix, and me vs Dude, Your Getting a Dell.

stories.title: I Chase Brown Kids lost by 10.38 with 16.2 on the bench and 31.88 on taxi
stories.dek: ZachCarroll09 is 4~7 with the most points of any team below .500. One lineup click would have made it 5~6.
body: This one's going to sting for a while. I Chase Brown Kids scored 135.78 in Week 11, more than Jefferson’s Reserve, The Champ, Bourbon Lover, OBJAY, Asian Jim, me and Dude, Your Getting a Dell. It was also more than two of the week's winners scored. I Chase Brown Kids just drew the 10~1 team.

But the lineup is the lineup. Adonai Mitchell started at receiver and caught two balls for 30 yards, 4.5 points. Rashod Bateman scored 16.2 on the bench. Swap them and I Chase Brown Kids wins by 1.32. Fernando Mendoza threw for 31.88 on the taxi squad while Cam Ward scored 28.22 and Daniels 18.06 in the two quarterback spots, so that one's a dynasty decision and I'll allow it. The Bateman one isn't.

Now it's 4~7 with three weeks left, two games behind Jefferson’s Reserve and The Champ for sixth with 1355.64 points. ZachCarroll09 has to win out and get help. Week 12 is Jefferson’s Reserve, a 6~5 team that's playing without Marvin Harrison Jr. and maybe Bhayshul Tuten. I made I Chase Brown Kids a 1-point favorite. Start Bateman.

stories.title: I put a running back who scored a touchdown Monday night in my IR slot. I'm 3~8.
stories.dek: Jacory Croskey-Merritt scored 16.7 in the reserve slot of StrngeJhnsonHurtsmyBoutte while Tyler Allgeier started and scored 2.8.
body: Final: The Champ 123.26, StrngeJhnsonHurtsmyBoutte 73.20. Samaje Perine did his job Monday with 97 total yards and 13.2 points. Joe Burrow and Tee Higgins did theirs, 35.7 between them. TJohn91 covered the 47.0 by 3.06. Fine. That part I expected.

Here's the part I didn't. Jacory Croskey-Merritt was active for Washington, got 15 touches and scored a touchdown in the same game Perine played in. 16.7 points. He was in my IR slot the entire time. Tyler Allgeier started at running back and scored 2.8. I watched the game. I saw him score. I said 'nice' out loud. For my team, I thought. It was not for my team.

Also on my bench: Devaughn Vele 13.6 and Kenyon Sadiq 7.0, while Ashton Dulin (4.5) and Brenton Strange (5.1) started. Make the three best swaps and I gain 24.9 points. I lost by 50.06, so I'd still have lost. I want that on the record. I'm bad, but I'm not that close to being good.

Week 12 is me against Dude, Your Getting a Dell, 3~8 vs 0~11, and I'm a 22-point favorite. Drake Maye's still Out, Carson Beck is Out again, so it's Josh Johnson Part II. I own 12 first-round picks over the next three drafts and I cannot be trusted with a Sleeper lineup screen. Br0phy, if you're going to win one, it's this week. Please don't.

stories.title: Three weeks, six spots: Jefferson’s Reserve and The Champ are 6~5, Asian Jim is a game back
stories.dek: Kraft for Cash and Catfan94’s Farm Team play for third. OBJAY and Asian Jim play for their lives. And everybody sets a lineup Wednesday.
body: Six teams make it and the playoffs start in Week 15, so it's Weeks 12, 13 and 14 left. LigmaBrocksAndLoveMyPenix and Hold My DK are 10~1. Catfan94’s Farm Team is 8~3 and Kraft for Cash 7~4. Then The Champ 6~5 with 1537.98 points and Jefferson’s Reserve 6~5 with 1380.50. Asian Jim is 5~6, I Chase Brown Kids and OBJAY 4~7, Bourbon Lover and me 3~8.

Points for breaks ties, and The Champ has 157.48 more than Jefferson’s Reserve, so jmello16 needs a better record than TJohn91, not a tie. The Champ gets Hold My DK this week as a 19-point underdog with Josh Jacobs Out and A.J. Brown Doubtful. Jefferson’s Reserve gets I Chase Brown Kids as a 1-point dog.

OBJAY vs Asian Jim is the elimination game. ManicOrientals has one quarterback on an NFL roster who's healthy, Tyler Shough, with Kyler Murray Out and Daniel Jones unsigned. JAY2913 has Geno Smith and Bo Nix. That's why OBJAY is a 7-point favorite in a matchup where the season averages are 0.19 apart.

And the calendar: Packers-Rams is Wednesday night at 8 PM ET. Jordan Love, Matthew Stafford, Kyren Williams, Tucker Kraft, Christian Watson and Matthew Golden lock then. Thursday is Bears-Lions, Eagles-Cowboys and Chiefs-Bills, so Jahmyr Gibbs, Dak Prescott, CeeDee Lamb, Patrick Mahomes and Josh Allen all go on Thanksgiving. If you're doing your lineup Sunday morning, half your team already played.

columns.title: HE PUT A TOUCHDOWN IN THE IR SLOT!! Bill_Buttlicker IS 3~8 AND I'M OUT OF DUNKIN'!!
columns.dek: Hugh G. Rection reviewed the Week 11 finals and had to lie down on the basement floor.
body: JACORY CROSKEY-MERRITT!! FIFTEEN TOUCHES!! A TOUCHDOWN ON MONDAY NIGHT!! 16.7 POINTS!! IN THE IR SLOT!! THE GUY WHO RUNS THIS WEBSITE WATCHED THE GAME AND SAID 'NICE'!! IT WASN'T NICE!! TYLER ALLGEIER STARTED AND SCORED 2.8!! I THREW A MUNCHKIN AT THE TV!!

AND I Chase Brown Kids!! DOWN 44.14 GOING INTO MONDAY!! JAYDEN DANIELS WALK-OFF DRIVE!! THEY GOT WITHIN 10.38!! AND RASHOD BATEMAN HAD 16.2 ON THE BENCH!! SIXTEEN POINT TWO!! THAT'S A WIN!! THAT WAS A WIN SITTING RIGHT THERE!! ZachCarroll09 LEFT A WIN ON THE BENCH LIKE A WALLET AT A DUNKIN'!!

AND LigmaBrocksAndLoveMyPenix!! 10~1!! SEVEN STRAIGHT!! JA'MARR CHASE GOT 5.6 AND THEY STILL WON!! Catfan94 COULD START HIS FANTASY TEAM'S BYE WEEKS AND WIN!! SOMEBODY STOP THIS MAN!! NOBODY CAN!! HE'S THE COMMISSIONER!!

AND IT'S THANKSGIVING WEEK!! THERE'S A WEDNESDAY GAME!! WEDNESDAY!! PACKERS AT RAMS!! IF YOUR LINEUP ISN'T SET BY 8 PM WEDNESDAY YOU DESERVE WHAT HAPPENS!! Bill_Buttlicker, I'M LOOKING AT YOU!! I'M ALWAYS LOOKING AT YOU!!

columns.title: ManicOrientals has one quarterback for a superflex elimination game. That's not bad luck. That's a plan that never happened.
columns.dek: Richard "Dick" Gozinya on Asian Jim, OBJAY, and the game where somebody's season ends Sunday.
body: Let me be clear about what's not anybody's fault. Kyler Murray being Out isn't ManicOrientals' fault. Nobody controls that. What I'm talking about is what happened next, and what didn't.

Daniel Jones got released by the Colts and his 4.06 counted in Week 11. Since then, Asian Jim has made one move: Dawson Knox for Tyler Goodson on Sunday morning. A tight end. In a league that starts two quarterbacks, the roster has Tyler Shough, Jack Strand on taxi listed Out, Murray, and an unsigned Jones. Meanwhile Jefferson’s Reserve has five quarterbacks and I Chase Brown Kids has six. Kirk Cousins is starting in Minnesota and sitting on jmello16's bench. Pick up the phone.

Now it's OBJAY vs Asian Jim, both teams averaging 116 points, and I've got JAY2913 as a touchdown favorite because he has Geno Smith and Bo Nix and ManicOrientals has Shough and a running back at superflex. That's the whole spread. When I played, if you showed up to the biggest game of the year with one helmet for two guys, the coach didn't call it bad luck. He called it Monday's film session.
JAY2913, don't get comfortable. You benched 122 receiving yards on Monday night. Antonio Williams plays this week too. Start him. Both of you toughen up.

columns.title: 6 Thanksgiving-week moves from Holden McGroin, who has already eaten the turkey and it's Tuesday
columns.dek: Holden McGroin's advice for Week 12. He has been told about the Wednesday game. He does not believe it.
body: 1. Bill_Buttlicker, leave Jacory Croskey-Merritt in the IR slot. He scored 16.7 there. If something works, you don't touch it. That's why I've had the same Sleeper password since 2017, which is 'password.'
2. ZachCarroll09, you lost by 10.38 with Rashod Bateman on the bench. The fix is obvious: bench Adonai Mitchell AND Bateman. Then neither one can hurt you. Defense wins championships.

3. Everybody, there's no game on Wednesday. Thanksgiving is Thursday. The NFL doesn't play on Wednesday, it's a known fact, I looked it up in my head. Set your lineup Sunday at 12:55 like a professional.
4. BTaylor1, Justin Herbert is Questionable, so start all three quarterbacks. Sleeper will stop you. Sleeper is a coward.

5. Br0phy, you're 0~11 against a guy who can't find his own IR slot. Trade your whole roster to Bill_Buttlicker before the game for his worst players. Then you're starting his team against your old team, which is his team. I don't know who wins. Neither does anyone. That's the edge.
6. paknight12, Dak Prescott scored 44.9 and 45.42 and you lost both. Bench him. You'll score less, but you'll lose by less, and losing by less is basically winning, according to me.

columns.title: LigmaBrocksAndLoveMyPenix has scored 1860.84 points. By my model that's 9.3% of a championship.
columns.dek: Ivana Humpalot updated the spreadsheet after Monday night and the spreadsheet updated her back.
body: LigmaBrocksAndLoveMyPenix has scored 1860.84 points this season. The league has scored 16,752.98 total, which means Catfan94's team owns 11.1% of all points scored this year. Multiply that by his 10 wins, divide by the 12 teams, carry the Bowers, and he has a 9.3% claim on the trophy before the playoffs start. That sounds low. It's per week. I'm filing it with the commissioners. He is one of them. It's approved.

I Chase Brown Kids lost by 10.38 with 16.2 points on the bench. That's 156% of the margin sitting on the bench. Any bench above 100% of the margin is what I call a Bench-Equivalent Win, or BEW. ZachCarroll09 leads the league in BEW this week with 1.56 and is still 4~7. The BEW does not show up in the standings. I've written to Sleeper.

Bill_Buttlicker scored 73.20 and had 16.7 in his IR slot, so 18.6% of his real points were imaginary. His record is 3~8, which, if you take away 18.6% of the losses, is 3~6.5. Statistically he's improving at not counting points.

Dude, Your Getting a Dell lost by 71.66 and covered by 3.34. That's the first cover of Br0phy's season, a 100% cover rate in weeks where I checked. Projected out over 17 weeks, Br0phy covers 17 times and wins 0. I call that a moral dynasty.

exits.t: Scored 16.2 on the I Chase Brown Kids bench in Week 11 while Adonai Mitchell started and scored 4.5. I Chase Brown Kids lost by 10.38. Bateman has done the math and would like a manager who has too.

Caught nine passes for 122 yards on Monday Night Football, 19.2 points, on the OBJAY bench while Emeka Egbuka (3.3) and Luther Burden III (2.8) started. OBJAY lost by 105.56. Would like a team that watches Monday night.
Scored 12.1 on the LigmaBrocksAndLoveMyPenix bench in Week 11 while Isaiah Likely started at tight end and scored 5.0. Catfan94 won anyway, which is somehow worse. Would like to be needed somewhere.

Scored 12.4 on the Jefferson’s Reserve bench in Week 11 while Bhayshul Tuten (7.8) and Travis Etienne Jr. (8.1) started. Has noticed jmello16 hasn't spent $1 of FAAB all year and suspects the lineup gets the same attention.

Scored 7.0 on the StrngeJhnsonHurtsmyBoutte bench in Week 11 while Brenton Strange started at tight end and scored 5.1. One of five tight ends on a roster whose starting quarterback is 40-year-old Josh Johnson. Has asked Bill_Buttlicker to trade him for literally a quarterback.

Scored 19.48 on the Hold My DK bench in Week 11 while Caleb Williams started and scored 18.84. He's 42, he's been in the league since 2005, and he'd like to know what he has to do to start for a 10~1 team.

facts: TJohn91 has won both titles on Sleeper. He went 12-2 in 2024 and 10-4 in 2025, and is 28-11 all time.
Bill_Buttlicker owns 12 first-round picks over the next three drafts, the most in the league. JAY2913 is next with six.
Catfan94's 243.58 in Week 5 this year is the highest score in league history, and his 232.54 in Week 10 is second. Nobody else has topped 198.64.
Bill_Buttlicker went 3-11 in 2024 and 4-10 in 2025, scored 54.86 in 2024 Week 3, the third-lowest score in league history, and is 10-29 all time.
Br0phy's 39.26 in Week 8 this year is the lowest score in league history by 14.78 points. Dude, Your Getting a Dell is 0-11.
